title: Forward Deployed, Asset Management (EMEA)
description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Rogo's Forward Deployed team consists of former bankers and investors who guide top financial institutions on how to apply AI in their day-to-day workflows and long-term strategy. You'll lead full-cycle client engagements, building consultative relationships and tailoring demos that resonate with investors and deal teams. Similar to how Solutions Architects secure the "technical win," you'll drive the "financial win" by translating Rogo's capabilities into real impact across banking and investing use cases.

 - Engage with bankers/investors at existing and prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges, and then explain and demonstrate the value of Rogo's AI solutions to address them.

 - Establish yourself as a credible expert in solving customers' specific problems (e.g., public company financial research, M&A advisory, company diligence workflows).

 - Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various financial firms, asking questions to validate how Rogo can add value and then showcasing Rogo's features and benefits relevant to each prospective client's potential use cases.

 - Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with bankers/investors, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.

 - Act as the "Voice of the Customer," using your industry perspective to help the broader sales team develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a financial services lens.

 - Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

 - Further the market perception of Rogo as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make bankers/investors better at their jobs.

 - Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

What You Will Need

 - 3+ years of front-office experience at a large asset manager.  

 - Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision-makers and build credibility at all levels.

 - Outstanding presentation skills, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

 - Curiosity about AI's potential to transform financial services.

 - Sales or client-facing experience, including business development and/or experience directly managing institutional client matters and relationships.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup.

title: Senior / Principal Data Scientist, EHR AI
locations: New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Raleigh-Durham, NC
description:
About Formation Bio 
 Formation Bio is a tech and AI driven pharma company differentiated by radically more efficient drug development.  
 Advancements in AI and drug discovery are creating more candidate drugs than the industry can progress because of the high cost and time of clinical trials. Recognizing that this development bottleneck may ultimately limit the number of new medicines that can reach patients, Formation Bio, founded in 2016 as TrialSpark Inc., has built technology platforms, processes, and capabilities to accelerate all aspects of drug development and clinical trials. Formation Bio partners, acquires, or in-licenses drugs from pharma companies, research organizations, and biotechs to develop programs past clinical proof of concept and beyond, ultimately helping to bring new medicines to patients. The company is backed by investors across pharma and tech, including a16z, Sequoia, Sanofi, Thrive Capital, John Doerr, Spark Capital, SV Angel Growth, and others. 
 You can read more at the following links:
 Our Vision for AI in Pharma 
 Our Current Drug Portfolio 
 Our Technology & Platform 
 At Formation Bio, our values are the driving force behind our mission to revolutionize the pharma industry. Every team and individual at the company shares these same values, and every team and individual plays a key part in our mission to bring new treatments to patients faster and more efficiently.
 About the Position 
 As a Senior or Principal Data Scientist on the EHR AI team at Formation Bio, you will build the models that let us learn from real-world data (RWD): electronic health records (EHR) together with claims and other real-world sources. You will work hands-on with longitudinal EHR and claims data to predict how disease progresses, how patients respond to treatment, and which approved drugs change the course of disease. The data spans large-scale, longitudinal EHR from health systems, linked to claims, clinical notes, and imaging, alongside biobank-scale genetic and molecular data. Your results become real-world evidence (RWE) that feeds directly into which drugs we acquire, which indications we pursue, and how we design trials.
 This is a hands-on modeling role. You will train and evaluate models, including EHR foundation models, define the cohorts and phenotypes they depend on, and turn results into clear answers for Business Development and R&D, often on tight timelines. On the technology side, you will work closely with Engineering and Product. At the Principal level, you will also lead a workstream end to end and mentor other scientists.
 Responsibilities 
 Build, train, and validate predictive models on longitudinal EHR and claims data: disease progression, time-to-event outcomes, and patient-level treatment response
 Benchmark and adapt EHR foundation models for patient representation against strong tabular and sequence baselines
 Define and validate computable phenotypes and cohorts using the OMOP CDM and standard vocabularies, including features derived from clinical notes
 Apply causal methods such as target trial emulation alongside predictive models to surface drugs that modify disease course
 Answer EHR and RWE questions from Business Development diligence and R&D programs on days-to-weeks timelines, with explicit statements of uncertainty and bias
 Write reproducible, reviewed code and work with Engineering and Product to turn prototypes into reusable tools
 Principal level: lead a modelin
